name: @mo-gallery/desktop-plugin-tencent-cos
description: Tencent Cloud Object Storage (COS) Desktop storage plugin.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:ui
scripts.build:main: tsc --noEmit false --outDir dist --declaration --declarationMap --sourceMap -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/main.js
